title: Doodle Brawl
description: Draw your own weapon, then fight with it. Your drawing really is the weapon: long reaches further, ink far from the handle hits harder but swings slower, tiny is lightning fast, and weird shapes become secret weapons like the Ninja Star and Hypno Swirl. Physics combat with combos, blocks, parries, dodges and specials, falling crates and TNT. Quick battles, Survival, three bosses, Chaos mode and online 1v1, plus daily challenges and weapon share links: can you beat my weapon?
